isolation_note: All 9 scenarios executed strictly on disposable QCOW2 copy-on-write clones; the base installed VM disk was never modified.
automation_distinction: Boot into BERE via GRUB, vault SHA-256 verification, Btrfs subvolume isolation, and systemd journal logging are automated; destructive rollback and boot-repair execution intentionally require explicit operator root-password authentication (mandatory BERE security lock).
